column1: # The Ubuntu packages the AppImage bundles whose copyright files are owed a
# reading against LICENSE-001 (PLATFORM-013): a package, a tab, and what the
# reading must settle. tool/check_bundle_licences.js --owed reports their
# refusals instead of failing on them, and fails on a package listed here,
# in a bundle that carries it, that no longer needs to be; the list only
# shrinks. A package leaves it once
# openspec/specs/legal/debian_licences.tsv reads every licence its file names,
# a GPL stanza read as covering files the binary package does not ship being a
# row of that package marking them LicenseRef-build-only, as libevent's are.
# While it holds a row, the Snap workflow keeps the AppImage to itself and
